title: Just Another Modpack
description: Madpack made for playing with friends, for fans of technical and adventure mods.
body:
# Just Another Mod Pack (v1.0.0) — Forge 1.20.1

A curated Forge 1.20.1 modpack (290 mods) focused on big exploration, fresh worldgen, and deep endgame tech — packed with new biomes, dungeons, dimensions, creatures, and quality-of-life improvements. Built for long survival playthroughs where you can roam, loot, build, and automate.

# What to expect?
Huge world variety (overhauled terrain + biomes)
Lots of structures & dungeons to discover and conquer
New realms/dimensions for late-game progression
Tech stack for automation, storage networks, power, and tools
Client QoL + performance mods for smoother gameplay
Optional resource packs + shader packs included

Minecraft: 1.20.1
Loader: Forge 47.4.13
Pack version: 1.0.0
